description: Short Toolkit orientation and ordered Knowledge reads for startup and context recovery.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$projectRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node (Join-Path $projectRoot '.claude/hooks/toolkit-session-start.mjs')"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$projectRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node (Join-Path $projectRoot '.claude/hooks/knowledge-session-start.mjs')"
$knowledgeRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $knowledgeRoot; node '.claude/hooks/memory-reminder.mjs'
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$knowledgeRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node (Join-Path $knowledgeRoot '.claude/hooks/save-reminder.mjs')"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$knowledgeRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node (Join-Path $knowledgeRoot '.claude/hooks/work-item-close.mjs')"
$knowledgeRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $knowledgeRoot; node '.claude/hooks/knowledge-completion.mjs'
